card.name: Author initials in citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation right after an author's name or initial in a reference or source line, such as the comma or period after "et. al" or "Linos, E". It also fires weakly on scattered words in eye-care and infection text.

modes.label: Citation author punctuation
modes.description: A period, comma or parenthesis after an author's name or initial in a reference list or SOURCES line.
modes.example: SOURCES:Linos, E<<.>> Cancer Causes & Control, June 2

modes.label: Eye and skin care wording
modes.description: Words in practical instructions about eyes or skin, such as ointment, crust or wash out.
